adjustments.name: Tobias Harris
adjustments.reason: Calf strain in camp; ESPN says he will miss the preseason and is questionable for the 20 Oct opener vs OKC. ESPN's return date is opening night, so no injury proposal covers it; -2 games for a likely slow start.

adjustments.name: Ben Simmons
adjustments.reason: Kings announced a torn Achilles requiring surgery, likely season-ending (ESPN/Shams Charania, team announcement 2026-10-18/19). Projection still had 34 games, so games set to 0.

adjustments.name: Pelle Larsson
adjustments.reason: RotoWire (2026-10-20): cleared from illness but "isn't expected to be a big part of the team's rotation for the foreseeable future". Not on the Miami depth chart, yet projected 23 mpg; cut to 12 as a deep-bench role.

adjustments.name: Ben Sheppard
adjustments.reason: Diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee, no timetable for return (Scott Agness, FieldhouseFiles.com). Meniscus tears typically cost 6-10 weeks or more; -20 games from his 63 projected, about 25% of a season.

adjustments.name: Jalen Williams
adjustments.reason: Dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, surgery on both, out indefinitely (ESPN/Shams Charania, via FantasyPros 2026-10-27; ESPN: Thunder guards out "for months"). No return date, so no injury proposal covers it. Ankle-dislocation plus fibula fracture surgery typically costs 4-6 months, i.e. back around March-April; ~10 games left this season, versus 66 projected.

adjustments.name: Cason Wallace
adjustments.reason: Torn labrum in left shoulder, surgery, out indefinitely (ESPN/Shams Charania, via FantasyPros 2026-10-27; ESPN: Thunder guards out "for months"). No return date, so no injury proposal covers it. Shoulder labrum repair typically costs 4-5 months; ~25 games after a return in March, versus 75 projected.

adjustments.name: Justin Champagnie
adjustments.reason: Foot fracture surgery; expected to miss several months per Josh Robbins (The Athletic), no clear timetable. Several months taken as ~3.5 months, about 30 of the remaining games, off his 68-game projection. No injury proposal exists for him.
